_source: Owner/CoS-maintained by hand — NOT harvested by scripts/registry-build.ts. The system of record for cloud routines is claude.ai (Code Routines), not this repo, so there is no manifest to harvest from. Edit this file directly whenever a routine is created, rescheduled, or retired in claude.ai, and bump `updated`. `registry:check` never rewrites or drops this file — the harvester (scripts/registry-build.ts) does not reference `routines.json` at all.
note: Lists only TIME-SCHEDULED cloud routines — the recurring cron-fired runners created in claude.ai that clone this repo and open PRs. EVENT-DRIVEN loops (fired by triggers inside a session, not a wall clock — e.g. `dev-cycle`, `ticket-cycle`, `decision`, `level-set`, `request-intake`, `new-app`, `heal`, `core-upgrade`) have no routine and so have no entry here; see registry/loops.json for the full loop set. For each routine below, this file is memory + a link target ([[adr-016]] zero-Claude-call rule) — it does not imply in-app control. The LIVE (self-tuned) cadence and run history are NOT duplicated here: read the named loop's most recent [[ledger]] `cadence-decision` block (`ran_at`, `trigger`, `next_cadence_days`, `reason`) — see the loop's own manifest for the protocol.

routines.name: Request triage
routines.note: UN-PAUSED 2026-09-22 by the Owner on claude.ai after [[work-115]] closed. It had been paused 2026-09-22 because console test helpers leaked ~200+ verbatim test fixtures into the shared Turso store (SCOPE_CREEP_DB_URL precedence shadowed the vitest :memory: pin), which the hourly sweep re-triaged, flooding the Console. Gate satisfied: (a) leak closed at source — scope-creep-console#74 merged to main (test-db isolation + fail-closed guard + 49-pair defensive denylist); (b) store clean — 318 fixture threads archived (reversible), leaving 1 genuine request active, verified read-only. HOURLY (:17) — the loop that closes the Request Loop ([[prd-request-loop]]). Runs in the custom cloud env 'scope-creep-local' (holds DATABASE_URL + DATABASE_AUTH_TOKEN, *.turso.io allowlisted) and clones scope-creep-console as a sibling for the triage CLI + shared thread store ([[adr-025]]). Runtime is Node (npm run triage), not bun (egress proxy drops bun's fetch). Cadence self-tunes per [[work-067]].

routines.name: Work sweep
routines.note: MIRROR of the claude.ai routine state, NOT the switch ([[adr-016]]) - flipping this field does NOT un-pause the routine; the Owner un-pauses at manage_url. Marked active only as the last step of the [[work-117]] un-pause, AFTER: (a) the reviewer PAT was removed from the scope-creep-local cloud env; (b) Administration/branch-protection write confirmed absent from the Claude App grant; (c) [[adr-023]] Phase-2 landed (human-only escalation code owner + [[work-094]]); (d) the [[adr-026]] supervised canary captured criteria 1/2/4/6 incl. the direct PUT /pulls/{n}/merge -> 405/409 probe; and (e) the Owner un-paused the routine at claude.ai. Tier-2 execution loop of [[prd-autonomous-execution-loop]] ([[work-086]]/[[work-087]]): authors PRs on cadence as the forced sandbox-proxy identity (propose-only); merge stays off-sandbox as @scope-creep-review; escalation-class tickets ALWAYS HOLD for the Owner, never self-disposed, even at Tier-2 ([[adr-022]]/[[adr-026]]). SUPERSEDES the earlier pause note (pending work-092/093 bot-path fixes + the [[ledger-066]] proxy-identity wall) - that write path is dead; the live path is ADR-026 propose-only. Cadence self-tunes per [[work-087]]. See [[ledger-072-work-sweep-unpause-safety-gates]].

routines.name: Board hygiene
routines.note: Tier-1 propose-only board-hygiene canary (ADR-026). Registered + supervised first run PASSED 2026-09-22 (opened #101 as the forced sandbox-proxy identity; merge structurally blocked by the code-owner gate) then un-paused. Edits only work/*.md status + opens ONE board-state-correction PR; never builds/merges. Runs in the scope-creep-local env (Node runtime), console sibling checkout. Cadence self-tunes per work-087; see ledger-071.
